something I need you to know

I'm sorry, jaan.

This part isn't about being cute. It's about being honest with you.

My jaan, I want to say something properly instead of brushing past it. I know that these past two or three days, I've hurt you unintentionally, and even if you shake it off or tell me it's okay, I don't want to assume that means it didn't affect you. I'm genuinely sorry, baby. I never want my words or actions to make you feel like your feelings don't matter to me. I know that not meaning to hurt you doesn't automatically make the hurt disappear, and I don't want to use my intentions as an excuse. You deserve care, respect, and the effort to understand you—not just an apology. I may not always get everything right, but I want to listen better, think before I react, and understand what hurt you instead of expecting you to get over it quickly. You don't have to pretend you're okay just to keep things peaceful with me. If something is still bothering you, I want you to feel safe enough to tell me. I love you, Karan. Not just when we're laughing and everything is easy, but also when we need to have an honest conversation and do better. I'm sorry for the moments these past few days when I made you feel hurt. I can't change those moments, but I can take responsibility for what I do next and try to be gentler with your heart. Thank you for being patient with me. You matter to me so much, jaan, and I don't want you to have to hide your hurt just because you love me. I'm listening, I'm learning, and I want to do better—not only say it. 🤍
I'm sorry, and I love you. — your Sanskriti ♡

A letter for you, jaan

Press the little button. No rushing. This one's yours.

to: Karan · from: your girl
Hey jaan, ♡ I know I may not always find the perfect words, but I hope you never have to guess how special you are to me. You have this way of staying on my mind even when we're doing completely different things. Sometimes it's the middle of the night and, out of all the thoughts my brain could possibly choose, it chooses you. Every single time. 🥹💗 I love the little things about us—the conversations, the silliness, the comfort, and the way a simple “hi” from you can change my whole mood. I don't need every day to be perfect. I just want us to keep being honest with each other, keep laughing at our nonsense, and keep making memories we'll smile about later. And babuu, please remember this: you don't have to be impressive every second to be loved. You can have difficult days, feel unsure, or simply be quiet. I want to know the real you, not some perfect version of you. Thank you for being you. I'm proud of you, I'm cheering for you, and I'm so grateful that our paths crossed. If I could put every soft thought I have about you into a little box, it would probably burst open with hearts. So here's the closest thing I can make: this tiny website, made with a very full heart. I love you, my Karan. Take care of yourself for me, okay? Eat properly, rest when you need to, and don't forget that someone out here is rooting for you—very loudly, even if I pretend to be cool. 🤍 Yours, with all my love,
your Sanskriti ♡
